description: Clark Kent moves to Metropolis, joins the Daily Planet and creates the public identity of Superman while working beside reporter Lois Lane. Their partnership develops into romance as Clark protects the city, guards his secret and faces threats ranging from Lex Luthor to Kryptonian and time-traveling adversaries. Season 4 in this collection runs from "Lord of the Flys" through "The Family Hour", preserving the collection-local episode order and source runtimes.

s04e01.description: Lois and Clark's relationship hangs in the balance as Clark is forced to adhere to Kryptonian law and marry the woman he was pledged to at birth.

s04e02.description: Clark faces charges of treason for betraying the people of New Krypton after returning to Earth to stop Lord Nor's hostile takeover.

s04e03.description: Lois and Clark must act quickly to prevent an old nemesis from destroying their impending wedding. In this Lois & Clark: The New Adventures of Superman episode, "Swear to God, This Time We're Not Kidding" develops that conflict through season 4 and carries its consequences into the surrounding story.

s04e04.description: The newlyweds travel back in time with H.G. Wells to remove a curse cast on the couple's love centuries ago.
